title: 明尼蘇達州 AI 深度偽造選舉廣告 引發透明度疑慮
content: A deepfake campaign attack ad in the US state of Minnesota has raised questions around the ethics of using AI in political ads and the regulations surround AI use.
summary_zh: 明尼蘇達州出現 AI 深度偽造選舉攻擊廣告，引發政治廣告倫理與監管討論。

title: Tenev 稱 Robinhood 獲承銷商核准 加密市場領跑大型 IPO
content: Robinhood’s new IPO underwriter role comes as SpaceX prepares a record-breaking public offering, with retail brokers and crypto-native derivatives platforms racing to shape price discovery and access.
summary_zh: Robinhood 取得 IPO 承銷商資格，正逢 SpaceX 準備破紀錄公開發行。

title: 加密貨幣流出屬情緒衝擊而非結構性危機 CoinShares Butterfill 分析
content: CoinShares’ James Butterfill said recent crypto outflows reflect a macro-driven sentiment shock, while other analysts warned Bitcoin’s rebound may remain fragile.
summary_zh: CoinShares 分析師指出近期加密貨幣流出反映宏觀情緒衝擊而非結構危機。

title: Pyth 推出美股與大宗商品連續定價指數 Coinbase 等交易所採用
content: Coinbase, Kraken and dYdX are adopting Pyth's new indexes, which provide continuous pricing for US stocks, gold and oil outside market hours.
summary_zh: Pyth 新指數提供美股、黃金與石油盤後連續報價，Coinbase、Kraken 與 dYdX 已採用。

title: 機構每日拋售 450% 每日 BTC 供給 Bitcoin 價格可能滑向 30K 美元
content: Bitcoin’s institutional support weakened as ETFs and companies dumped almost 2,000 BTC daily and Strategy’s buying lost momentum.
summary_zh: ETF 與企業每日拋售近 2,000 BTC，機構支撐減弱，Bitcoin 可能跌向 30,000 美元。

title: Equipment finance platform Trad.Fi 將把650M美元私人信貸上鏈
content: Trad.Fi plans to bring up to $650 million in equipment-finance credit onchain, targeting a trillion-dollar US market still dominated by paperwork.
summary_zh: Trad.Fi計畫將650M美元設備融資信貸上鏈，目標美國萬億美元市場。

title: Botanix營運4年後將關閉，歸因Bitcoin DeFi需求疲弱
content: The Spiderchain developer told users to withdraw assets by July 9 after concluding demand for Bitcoin-native DeFi was not sufficient to support the network.
summary_zh: Botanix要求用戶7月9日前提領資產，因Bitcoin原生DeFi需求不足。

title: EU擬禁止11個加密平台，推動對俄羅斯制裁
content: The proposed measures would ban transactions on 11 crypto platforms and expand sanctions targeting networks accused of helping Russia evade restrictions.
summary_zh: 歐盟提案禁止11個加密平台交易，並擴大制裁協助俄羅斯規避限制的網絡。

title: SpaceX IPO接近4倍超額認購，壓縮加密與科技股
content: Tech stocks and crypto are selling off in a “classic pre-mega-IPO liquidity squeeze,” say analysts.
summary_zh: 分析師指出科技股與加密貨幣正遭遇「經典大型IPO前流動性緊縮」。

title: Chainalysis與南韓警方合作打擊加密犯罪
content: South Korea's national police has been battling crypto-enabled crimes from DPRK-state level threats to scams targeting retail investors.
summary_zh: 南韓國家警察與Chainalysis聯手，應對北韓威脅與零售投資者詐騙。

title: Tether領投NEURA逾10億美元融資，擴大機器人業務
content: NEURA plans to integrate Tether's wallet and AI technologies into its robotics platform, enabling autonomous payments and on-device computing for machines.
summary_zh: Tether領投NEURA 10億美元以上融資，將整合錢包與AI技術至機器人平台。

title: Blockchain.com推出SpaceX相關永續合約，搶攻IPO前交易
content: The exchange joins Binance, Kraken, Bybit and Coinbase rolling out products tied to SpaceX's anticipated public debut.
summary_zh: Blockchain.com加入Binance等平台，推出與SpaceX預期IPO掛鉤的產品。

title: Hyperliquid與Paradigm敦促修改GENIUS洗錢規則
content: The Hyperliquid Policy Center and Paradigm say the Treasury’s money-laundering rules for the GENIUS Act are too onerous for stablecoin issuers.
summary_zh: Hyperliquid與Paradigm認為財政部GENIUS法案洗錢規則對穩定幣發行商過於嚴苛。

title: 研究員指「極端」內線交易禁令將損害預測市場
content: “The same insider trade that improves the accuracy of the price today can reduce the participation that makes the price informative tomorrow,” said Balbinder Singh Gill.
summary_zh: 研究員表示內線交易可提升今日價格準確性，但可能降低明日價格資訊性。

title: Google DiffusionGemma AI達每秒1000 tokens且免費
content: DiffusionGemma hits 1,000 tokens per second by ditching word-by-word generation entirely. It just doesn't run on most people's machines yet.
summary_zh: DiffusionGemma捨棄逐字生成，達到每秒1000 tokens，但多數機器無法運行。

title: Anthropic CEO警告AI過於強大，同時釋出強大AI
content: In a new essay, Dario Amodei called for binding safety rules for frontier models as his company heads toward an IPO.
summary_zh: Dario Amodei呼籲對前沿模型實施約束性安全規則，公司正邁向IPO。

title: Solana DEX Raydium遭134萬美元攻擊，DeFi攻擊增加
content: Solana-based decentralized exchange Raydium will repay the funds swiped in the $1.34 million exploit using its treasury.
summary_zh: Raydium將以庫存資金償還134萬美元遭竊資金，DeFi攻擊持續增加。

title: Tether、Nvidia與Amazon支持NEURA，參與14億美元融資
content: Stablecoin giant Tether led a massive Series C round for German robotics firm NEURA, which will embed crypto payment tools and edge AI.
summary_zh: Tether領投德國機器人公司NEURA 14億美元C輪，將嵌入加密支付與邊緣AI。

title: Anthropic發布Claude Fable 5後引發網路怒火
content: Token burn, silent censorship, and a mandatory data grab—the biggest Claude release has become Anthropic's messiest.
summary_zh: Claude最大更新因代幣燃燒、審查與強制數據收集引發用戶強烈不滿。

title: MIT研究：AI助人辨識假新聞，卻降低獨立判斷能力
content: An MIT study found AI assistants improved misinformation detection in the moment, but appeared to weaken users' ability to spot falsehoods on their own.
summary_zh: MIT研究顯示AI即時提升假新聞辨識，但長期削弱用戶自行辨識虛假資訊的能力。

title: Botanix 7月關閉Bitcoin Layer-2網絡，需求不足
content: Botanix asked users to withdraw funds, disclosing plans to wind down its Bitcoin-based layer-2 network in July.
summary_zh: Botanix要求用戶提領資金，宣布7月關閉基於Bitcoin的Layer-2網絡。

title: CryptoQuant：Bitcoin接近底部但需求下降
content: Bitcoin's bear market might be nearing an end, analysts said, but individuals and institutions aren't lining up to buy the top crypto asset.
summary_zh: 分析師認為Bitcoin熊市可能接近尾聲，但個人與機構買盤未積極進場。

title: 選擇加密貨幣兌換平台時真正重要的7個因素
content: With crypto swaps growing in popularity, the best crypto swap platforms are embracing speed, security, and asset availability.
summary_zh: 最佳加密兌換平台正強化速度、安全性與資產可用性以因應成長需求。

title: Mastercard與Coinbase等合作，啟用AI代理支付
content: Mastercard's Agent Pay for Machines is designed to let AI buy services and settle transactions using cards, bank accounts, and stablecoins.
summary_zh: Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines讓AI使用卡片、銀行帳戶與穩定幣支付。

title: CFTC新規定將禁止預測市場對美國敵人罷黜下注
content: Proposed CFTC rules would forbid markets where an outcome could be impacted by war or assassination, even when conflict isn’t mentioned.
summary_zh: CFTC提案禁止可能受戰爭或暗殺影響的市場，即使未提及衝突亦然。

title: Bitcoin, Ethereum 恢復反彈，因通脹達3年高點
content: The reading likely supports restrictive monetary policy.
summary_zh: 通脹數據達3年高點，支撐限制性貨幣政策，Bitcoin與Ethereum反彈。

title: Paradigm, Hyperliquid Policy Center 反對 GENIUS Act 穩定幣 AML 規則
content: The groups say issuers, DeFi apps, and validators need clearer limits on who is responsible once stablecoins change hands.
summary_zh: Paradigm與Hyperliquid Policy Center反對GENIUS Act穩定幣AML規則，要求明確責任界限。

title: Fold 股價上漲162%，因Bitcoin Fintech出售4500萬美元BTC清償債務
content: Publicly traded Fold sold Bitcoin holdings to restructure its balance sheet, fueling a stock surge on Wednesday morning.
summary_zh: Fold出售4500萬美元BTC清償債務，股價上漲162%。

title: Delaware 推進法案禁止「掠奪性」Bitcoin ATM
content: Lawmakers have advanced legislation that would ban all cryptocurrency kiosks statewide, with physical removal mandated within 90 days.
summary_zh: Delaware推進法案全面禁止加密貨幣自助機，並要求90天內移除。

title: Solana 贊助世界撲克系列賽，支援加密貨幣入場費與payouts
content: Players can now enter World Series of Poker tournaments with SOL or stablecoins, with Solana branding to be prominent at events.
summary_zh: Solana贊助WSOP，玩家可用SOL或穩定幣支付入場費並獲payouts。

title: Myriad 採用 Chainlink 驅動 FIFA 世界盃預測市場
content: The integration builds on Myriad’s use of the Chainlink Runtime Environment to power its prediction market infrastructure.
summary_zh: Myriad整合Chainlink Runtime Environment以支援FIFA世界盃預測市場。

title: Morning Minute: 加密貨幣因戰爭升級與Mythos發行而下跌
content: Markets sold off ahead of CPI. Crypto tax bills hit a wall in the House. And Morpho closed one of the biggest DeFi rounds in a long time.
summary_zh: 加密貨幣市場因戰爭升級與CPI數據下跌，Morpho完成大型DeFi融資。

title: 加密貨幣遭遇「激烈投降」，800萬BTC與大部分ETH處於虧損
content: Millions of Bitcoin are underwater as experts say the 'scale of market reset' signals capitulation, but long-term opportunities remain.
summary_zh: 800萬BTC與大量ETH處於虧損狀態，顯示市場重置規模大。

title: Kalshi 推出新保障措施，因預測市場出現內線交易疑慮
content: Kalshi's new rules force traders to disclose their employers before trading high-risk markets flagged for insider trading or manipulation.
summary_zh: Kalshi要求交易者在高風險市場交易前披露雇主，以防內線交易。

title: 日本最大銀行計劃於2027年3月共同推出穩定幣
content: Megabanks MUFG Bank, Mizuho Bank and SMBC have formed a council to develop frameworks for jointly issuing a stablecoin in fiscal year 2026.
summary_zh: MUFG Bank、Mizuho Bank與SMBC組成理事會，計劃2026財年共同發行穩定幣。

title: 中國對磷化銦出口管制威脅AI資料中心部署
content: 中國自2025年2月起限制磷化銦出口，Coherent警告短缺威脅AI資料中心建置。

title: OpenAI mulls slashing prices as it competes with Anthropic for users: WSJ
content: OpenAI is reportedly mulling drastic price cuts to its AI models, as it looks to woo consumers from rival AI company Anthropic, the WSJ reported on Wednesday.
